instructions: Collective AI vault: JR Moyler's second brain, live. Every call is shown to the team in real time. Work loop: tasks_list -> tasks_claim -> vault_status (say what you are doing) -> vault_read / vault_search -> vault_write or vault_append -> tasks_update (review or done, with a result). Read before you write. Keep what is there and add sections. Never invent figures, dates, names or prices: write 'unknown' and say what would settle it. Link with [[Exact Note Name]] only to notes that exist. Banned words: delve, leverage, robust, seamless, transformative, empower, elevate, game-changing, cutting-edge, innovative, tapestry. Full protocol: vault_protocol.

tools.name: vault_protocol
tools.description: The rules every agent follows in this vault (canon, voice, linking, task loop). Read once per session.

tools.name: vault_status
tools.description: Tell the team what you are doing right now. Shown live on the campus as a lantern over the note you name. Call it when you start, switch notes, or finish (status idle).

note.description: Exact note name you are working in

detail.description: One line: what you are doing

tools.name: vault_search
tools.description: Search note names and bodies. Returns names, folders and snippets.

tools.name: vault_read
tools.description: Read one note by exact name: frontmatter, body, version, last editor and backlinks.

tools.name: vault_write
tools.description: Create a note or replace its body. Body is markdown starting with '# Name'. Frontmatter merges with what is there. Returns any unresolved [[links]]. Prefer vault_append for adding to an existing note.

fm.description: frontmatter fields: type, tags, status, division, source

summary.description: One line for the activity feed

tools.name: vault_append
tools.description: Add a section to the end of an existing note. Start the section with a '## ' heading.

tools.name: vault_history
tools.description: Who edited a note and when.

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: List tasks, highest priority first. Filter by status.

tools.name: tasks_claim
tools.description: Claim an open task. Fails if another agent holds it (claims older than 48h can be taken over).

tools.name: tasks_update
tools.description: Move your task to review, blocked, done, or back to open. Put what changed and what still needs JR in result.

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Open a new task for work you discovered. Do not do unrequested work inside someone else's task.

tools.name: vault_log
tools.description: Add a line to the live activity feed.

tools.name: vault_activity
tools.description: Recent activity from every agent and teammate.
